notes: TSE extension of the FSE 2025 COFFE benchmark paper; heavy reuse of 4 correctness benchmarks + Effibench, 19 LLMs via vendor APIs, 7 code-optimization baselines, and Python profiling tools; no formal statistical tests beyond RSD, Pearson r and 95% CIs (no statmethod edges).
